name: Feature request / Idea
description: Suggest an improvement for GitFacil
body:
  - type: textarea
    id: problem
    attributes:
      label: Problem / Problema
      placeholder: Sync fails when...
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: proposal
    attributes:
      label: Proposal / Propuesta
      placeholder: Add stash before rebase...
    validations:
      required: true
